Correction: The association between preventive health and outpatient spending and life expectancy by income quartile

Mason S. Barnard1 and Rama M. Hagos1,2*

## Correction: Int J Equity Health 21, 159 (2022) https://doi.org/10.1186/s12939-022-01748-8

After publication of this article [1], the authors reported that in the Funding information section the following was missing: ’This publication was supported by the Princeton University Library Open Access Fund.’ The original article [1] has been corrected.

Reference 1. Barnard MS, Hagos RM. The association between preventive health and outpatient spending and life expectancy by income quartile. Int J Equity Health. 2022;21:159. https://​doi.​org/​10.​1186/​s12939-​022-​01748-8.

The original article can be found online at https://​doi.​org/​10.​1186/​s12939-​ 022-​01748-8.
